scope: Stage 7 package, runtime operations, deployment manager, Dockerfile, CPU/CUDA Compose and Linux environment lock

findings.finding: Recovery after failed activation must restore the last healthy active deployment
findings.resolution: pending.json preserves last_healthy; rollback uses it when activation is incomplete or failed
findings.verification: Reviewer inspected correction; successful full-image rollback also exercised manually. Failed activation branch was inspected, not deliberately induced

findings.finding: Rollback must use historical image ID rather than newest build pointer
findings.resolution: Historical image_id and manifest hash are passed explicitly and checked; completed releases cannot be rebuilt
findings.verification: Actual CUDA r3 to CPU r2 rollback restored the historical image ID and healthy HTTP service

findings.finding: Pin the uv build tool by digest
Locally named MinIO image cannot be fetched from public registry on an empty cache
findings.resolution: Pin local image ID and export archive; preserve operational state and volumes
findings.verification: Archive exported and docker image load restored the same MinIO image ID

runtime_observations: CPU mode had no GPU device request; CUDA mode reserved one NVIDIA GPU and resolved cuda:0
Root filesystem read-only, user 10001:10001, state volume and read-only secret mounts verified
Private MinIO bucket and absence of lifecycle expiration verified
Four original images remained byte-identical after container recreation and rollback
Ultralytics settings directory falls back to writable /tmp; frozen inference artifacts remain verified
out_of_scope_rulings: Scientific quality remains represented by the approved frozen E1/E2 reports; no retraining or tuning performed
Remote publication and disaster recovery on another host were not performed
The first approved model has no preceding different approved trained model; r2/r3 validate packaging and device rollback with identical weights
